Estimated from the photo, the tray holds:

- Toast, 1 slice of thick whole-grain bread: about 110 kcal, 5 g protein, 20 g carbs, 1.5 g fat. It looks dry, so I assumed no butter.
- Strawberries, about 1 cup halved (roughly 150 g): about 50 kcal, 1 g protein, 12 g carbs, 0.5 g fat.
- Two eggs, sunny-side up or over-easy, probably cooked with a little oil: about 180 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat.
- Avocado, about half a fruit (70 g): about 115 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 6 g carbs, 10 g fat.
- Lemon wedge: about 3 kcal, negligible macros.
- Latte, about 8 oz with milk: about 100 kcal, 6 g protein, 9 g carbs, 4 g fat.

Served total is about 560 kcal.

I assumed the person leaves very little. The lemon and possibly some of the coffee will probably go uneaten, so I put leftovers at about 20 kcal, which makes about 540 kcal eaten.

Macros eaten, summed from the items above and trimmed slightly for leftovers: about 25 g protein, 47 g carbs and 30 g fat.
